notes:
### 1. Product Overview
Notion is an all-in-one productivity and project management workspace that integrates notes, tasks, wikis, and relational databases into a single collaborative platform.
* **Source:** `apis.io` (via Google Search)
* **Quote:** "Notion is an all-in-one workspace that combines notes, tasks, wikis, and databases."
* **Source:** `https://www.notion.com/pricing`
* **Quote:** "for individuals to organize personal projects and life."

### 2. Authentication Methods & Multi-Tenant Integration
The Notion API supports three primary forms of authentication, all utilizing bearer tokens passed via the HTTP Authorization header.
* **Authentication Methods:** Internal connections (workspace-specific bots), Personal Access Tokens (PATs), and Public connections (OAuth 2.0).
* **Source:** `https://developers.notion.com/reference/authentication`
* **Quote:** "bearer tokens are provided when you create an internal connection , create a personal access token , or complete the oauth flow for a public connection ."
* **Primary Auth for Multi-Tenant Platforms:** `oauth2`. A multi-tenant integration platform must use public connections via OAuth 2.0 to allow end-users to securely authorize access to their respective Notion workspaces.
* **Source:** `https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro`
* **Quote:** "use an installation access token from an internal connection, an oauth access token from a public connection, or a personal access token ."

### 3. Developer Credentials & Cost
* **Access Tier:** `self_serve_free`
* **Cost & Process:** Free. Any developer can sign up for a standard Notion account and immediately create integrations via the developer portal without paying or undergoing manual approval, partner reviews, or sales interactions. Testing can be conducted entirely within a free personal workspace.
* **Source:** `https://www.notion.com/pricing`
* **Quote:** "essentials for staying organized. free $0 per member / month"
* **Source:** `https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro`
* **Quote:** "create a personal workspace for free or use a pat where workspace policy allows it."

### 4. API Technical Profile
* **API Style:** REST
* **Source:** `https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro`
* **Quote:** "The notion api follows restful conventions when possible, with most operations performed via get , post , patch , and delete requests on page and database resources."
* **Breadth:** High. The API exposes endpoints for managing blocks, pages, databases, data sources, comments, views, file uploads, search, users, custom emojis, and agent skills.
* **Source:** `https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro`
* **Quote:** "use the api to access notion’s pages, databases, and users. connections can connect services to notion and build interactive experiences for users within notion."
* **OpenAPI Spec:** Notion does not officially publish a standalone public OpenAPI specification file.
* **Source:** `latenode.com` (via Google Search)
* **Quote:** "Nope, Notion doesn't share their OpenAPI spec publicly. I hit the same wall last year while building a client library. Their documentation looks auto-generated from OpenAPI, but they keep the actual file locked down."
* **Webhooks:** Yes, Notion supports native webhooks that deliver real-time event notifications for workspace activity.
* **Source:** `notion.com` webhooks guide (via Google Search)
* **Quote:** "Webhooks let your connection receive real-time updates from Notion. Whenever a page or database changes, Notion sends a secure HTTP POST request to your webhook endpoint."
* **Sandbox:** Notion does not provide a dedicated sandbox environment, but developers can create a free personal workspace for testing.
* **Source:** `https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro`
* **Quote:** "create a personal workspace for free"

### 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers
* **MCP Availability:** `official`
* **Details:** Notion provides an official hosted MCP server (`mcp.notion.com`) that authenticates via OAuth. They also published an open-source local implementation (`makenotion/notion-mcp-server`), which is now soft-deprecated in favor of the hosted version. Community alternatives (e.g., `easy-notion-mcp`) also exist.
* **Source:** `growthmethod.com` (via Google Search)
* **Quote:** "Yes - Notion runs a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at mcp.notion.com , authenticated with one-click OAuth, and it's now the server Notion actively points teams towards."
* **Source:** `github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server` (via Google Search)
* **Quote:** "For the best experience, use Remote Notion MCP, our official hosted MCP server. This repository is a separate, self-hosted MCP server implementation that is no longer actively maintained or supported."

### 6. Buildability Verdict
* **Verdict:** `ready_now`
* **Main Blocker:** None. The platform provides comprehensive public documentation, self-serve free developer access, standard OAuth 2.0 authentication, and native webhooks, making it fully ready for immediate toolkit deployment.
